title: Every punctured chart section has a power multiple lifting to matching sections
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $C$ its maximal-ideal completion, and $U\subseteq\operatorname{Spec} A$ the complement of the closed point. Let $q:Y\to U$ and $s:E\to\operatorname{Spec} C$ be finite morphisms, and let $D$ be completion overlap data, with its matching ring $B$, base map $b:A\to B$, model map $m:\operatorname{Spec} B\to\operatorname{Spec} A$, and punctured comparison $p:Y\to m^{-1}(U)$, all as in [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Fix $f\in A$ with $D(f)\subseteq U$. Put $W=(m|_U)^{-1}((U\to\operatorname{Spec} A)^{-1}(D(f)))$ and $j:W\to\operatorname{Spec} B$ the composite of the two open inclusions. Let $\rho:B\to\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)$ be the composite of the inverse affine global-section isomorphism with $j^*$, and $\psi:\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(p^{-1}(W),\mathcal O)$ the pullback under $p|_W$. For every $t\in\Gamma(p^{-1}(W),\mathcal O)$, there exist $n\in\mathbb N$ and $x\in B$ such that $\psi(\rho(x))=\psi(\rho(b(f)))^n t$.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, proof, affine charts and matching algebra; Tag 05ER, proof, localized chart comparison using Tags 05EP and 05EQ. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BLH and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05ER.

proof.text: The closed point is outside D(f), hence f is in the maximal ideal. Use fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family on its Noetherian finite generation, and prepend f using Fin.cons. Its range is the old range with f inserted; the two span inclusions show that this enlarged family still generates the maximal ideal. Its index zero has parameter f.

Apply exists_formalGlueingData_matching_chart to the enlarged generating family at index zero. Obtain the formal datum X, a linear equivalence b from H0 to the matching ring, and a linear equivalence c from the f-chart module to the section ring of puncturedMap inverse image of W. For each h, the chart realization gives psi(rho(b(h)))=c(h_0), and its scalar action is explicitly induced by psi composed with rho composed with baseMap.

AdicCompletion.flat_of_isNoetherian and RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff give flatness of A to its maximal-ideal completion. For a chart section t, apply h0_chart_power_lift to c inverse of t to get n,h with h_0=f^n times c inverse of t. Choose b(h). The chart realization, c.map_smul and c.apply_symm_apply identify its image with f^n acting on t. Under the specified scalar action this is psi(rho(baseMap(f^n)))*t; map_pow gives psi(rho(baseMap(f)))^n*t.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BLH and 05ER. The geometric chart/equalizer construction is isolated in lem-sbc-punctured-completion-formal-glueing-chart; Lean proves finite-generation reindexing, flatness specialization, application of h0_chart_power_lift and scalar transport.

lean.statement:
theorem puncturedMatching_chart_power_lift
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A)
    (hf : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f : (Spec (.of A)).Opens) ≤ U) :
    let W := (D.modelMap ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
    let ρ := ((ΓSpecIso D.matchingRing).inv ≫
      (W.ι ≫ (D.modelMap ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).appTop).hom
    let ψ := (D.puncturedMap ∣_ W).appTop.hom
    ∀ t : Γ((D.puncturedMap ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme, ⊤),
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (b : D.matchingRing),
        ψ (ρ b) = ψ (ρ (D.baseMap.hom f)) ^ n * t
